description: A TIMING probe, not a modelling run: the FIFO control for phys_timing2_base_25pct - identical in every declared value except qsim.linkDynamics, which reverts to MATSim's FIFO default that the all-physical model silently ran under before 9.59. The pair measures what PassingQ (a 1.25 m/s pedestrian no longer holds the head of a shared link's queue against the cars behind it) is worth in wall time; its correctness case stands independently of this number (RUN.qsim.link_dynamics). NOTHING PRODUCED UNDER THIS OVERLAY IS A RESULT.

justification.RUN.controler.last_iteration: The declared sweep starts at 250 because that is the largest value MEASURED to be insufficient for convergence (DECISIONS.md 9.7, 9.43), so the range describes candidate MODELLING runs. This is a wall-clock control measurement. The value is deliberately far below the declared range so any output carrying it is obviously not a result.
